technical_and_design_decisions: Use Maven Shade Plugin with custom transformers to enforce dependency convergence and prevent external libraries from overriding existing ones in the uber-jar (U1).

Port the Spring XD SFTP module to Spring Cloud Stream by implementing the Source interface and adapting to the Spring Cloud Stream programming model (U3).
Create a new 'spring-cloud-dataflow-commons' module to house @RedisRule and related test utilities, making them reusable across test suites (U4).
Design a processor module registration foundation that discovers and registers processor modules from the Spring Cloud Stream Modules repository (U5).
Extend AetherModuleResolver with an offline mode that resolves artifacts from the local Maven repository using Aether's local repository API (U6).
Implement ModuleRegistry as a Spring-managed bean with an in-memory map for module name to coordinate lookup, populated from Maven metadata (U7).
Use Spring Shell to implement the module CLI commands (info, list, register, unregister) interacting with ModuleRegistry (U8).

ModuleRegistry will operate within a single JVM; distributed registry requirements are out of scope.
Offline mode for AetherModuleResolver only requires reading from the standard local Maven repository (~/.m2/repository).
All new code follows existing project coding standards, test coverage thresholds, and documentation practices.
The 's-c-d', 's-c-s', and 's-c-s-m' repositories refer to Spring Cloud Data Flow, Spring Cloud Stream, and Spring Cloud Stream Modules respectively.

activities.activity_name: Test offline mode with local Maven repository
activities.activity_description: Verify that module resolution works without network access by populating the local repo with required artifacts and running resolution in offline mode.

activities.activity_name: Design ModuleRegistry interface and data model
activities.activity_description: Define the ModuleRegistry interface with methods for register, unregister, findByName, listAll, and the ModuleCoordinate data class (group, artifact, version, type).

activities.activity_name: Implement ModuleRegistry with in-memory lookup
activities.activity_description: Provide a default implementation using a ConcurrentHashMap for thread-safe module name to coordinate mapping; include initialization from configuration or discovered modules.

activities.activity_name: Implement module coordinate resolution from Maven metadata
activities.activity_description: Add logic to resolve a module name to its Maven coordinates by consulting the ModuleRegistry's map, potentially falling back to AetherModuleResolver for version resolution.

activities.activity_name: Write unit and integration tests for ModuleRegistry
activities.activity_description: Test registration, lookup, concurrency, and integration with the module resolver; cover edge cases like duplicate names, missing modules.

activities.activity_name: Design Spring Shell command structure for module commands
activities.activity_description: Define the command hierarchy (module info, module list, module register, module unregister) and their parameters, help text, and completion providers.

activities.activity_name: Implement module info command
activities.activity_description: Create a command that displays detailed metadata for a given module name (coordinates, version, description) by querying ModuleRegistry.

activities.activity_name: Implement module list command
activities.activity_description: Create a command that lists all registered modules with their names and coordinates, supporting optional filtering.

activities.activity_name: Implement module register command
activities.activity_description: Create a command to register a new module by name and Maven coordinates (group:artifact:version), updating ModuleRegistry.

activities.activity_name: Implement module unregister command
activities.activity_description: Create a command to unregister a module by name, removing it from ModuleRegistry.

activities.activity_name: Add command validation, help, and error handling
activities.activity_description: Implement parameter validation, meaningful error messages, and comprehensive help for all module commands.

activities.activity_name: Integration test all module commands with ModuleRegistry
activities.activity_description: Run end-to-end tests of the shell commands against a running ModuleRegistry instance, verifying correct behavior and output.
